chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: We have already clarified the aspect of this report in the Book of al-Diyat.

key_terms.كِتَابِ ٱلدِّيَاتِ: the Book of al-Diyat, the section dealing with blood-money and related legal rulings
key_terms.هَٰذَا: this, referring to the present report
key_terms.ٱلْخَبَرِ: the report or hadith under discussion
key_terms.ٱلْوَجْهَ: the legal aspect or interpretive basis

ai.seo_question: Where did Muhammad ibn al-Hasan explain the legal basis of this report?
ai.summary: This statement is a cross-reference by Muhammad ibn al-Hasan to an earlier explanation of the legal reasoning related to this hadith. It indicates that the ruling connected to this report was discussed in detail in the section on blood-money and legal retaliation.
